nodes.description: Owner address state variable in Ownable; set to msg.sender in constructor and updated in transferOwnership.
ERC20 token interface stored in TokenDistribution; the token whose tokens are distributed.
Source wallet address from which transferFrom pulls tokens in sendToken.
Constructor of Ownable that assigns owner = msg.sender.
onlyOwner modifier requiring msg.sender == owner.
Transfers ownership to newOwner; guarded by onlyOwner, rejects address(0).
SafeMath multiplication with overflow assertion.
SafeMath integer division truncating the quotient.
SafeMath subtraction asserting b <= a to prevent underflow.
SafeMath addition asserting c >= a to prevent overflow.
ERC20Basic interface function totalSupply().
ERC20Basic interface function balanceOf(address who).
ERC20Basic interface function transfer(address to, uint256 value).
ERC20 interface function allowance(address owner, address spender).
ERC20 interface function transferFrom(address from, address to, uint256 value).
ERC20 interface function approve(address spender, uint256 value).
Constructor of TokenDistribution validating and storing token and wallet.
onlyOwner function looping over beneficiaries calling token.transferFrom(wallet, beneficiary, amount).
Caller-supplied address used for ownership assignment and onlyOwner authorization.
Assignment owner = msg.sender performed in the Ownable constructor.
require(msg.sender == owner) authorization check in the onlyOwner modifier.
External call token.transferFrom(wallet, beneficiary, amount) executed inside an unbounded loop; return value checked but external call can reenter.
Multiplication a * b that can overflow in Solidity 0.4.18 arithmetic.
Subtraction a - b that can underflow in Solidity 0.4.18 arithmetic.
Addition a + b that can overflow in Solidity 0.4.18 arithmetic.

edges.reason: msg.sender is written into the owner state variable in the Ownable constructor, so caller identity controls ownership.
The Ownable constructor executes the owner = msg.sender assignment.
msg.sender is compared against owner in the onlyOwner require check.
The owner state variable is read by the onlyOwner authorization check.
The onlyOwner modifier performs the require(msg.sender == owner) check.
The onlyOwner modifier gates execution of transferOwnership.
Authorization check result controls whether transferOwnership body executes.
newOwner parameter is used inside transferOwnership.
newOwner is assigned to the owner state variable, changing privileged ownership.
transferOwnership reads and overwrites the owner state variable.
_token parameter flows into the TokenDistribution constructor.
_wallet parameter flows into the TokenDistribution constructor.
_token is stored into the token state variable.
_wallet is stored into the wallet state variable.
_beneficiaries array parameter flows into sendToken.
_amount parameter flows into sendToken.
_beneficiaries.length bounds the loop index i.
Loop index i indexes the beneficiaries used in the transferFrom call.
Beneficiary address from _beneficiaries is passed as the transferFrom recipient.
_amount is passed as the value to token.transferFrom.
wallet state variable is passed as the from argument of token.transferFrom.
token state variable is the target contract of the external transferFrom call.
External call token.transferFrom can reenter sendToken before the loop completes, allowing repeated/unchecked distributions.

Parameter b is an operand of the multiplication a * b.
The multiplication result flows to the return computation and overflow assertion in mul.
Local variable c holds the mul result and is returned.

Parameter b flows into the division in SafeMath.div.
Local variable c holds the div result and is returned.

Parameter b is the subtrahend of a - b.
The subtraction result flows to the return value of sub.
Parameter a is an operand of the addition a + b.
Parameter b is an operand of the addition a + b.
The addition result flows to the return value and overflow assertion in add.
Local variable c holds the add result and is returned.

normalization_plan.reason: newOwner is only meaningful as the input to transferOwnership and should be folded into that function node.
_token is only used to initialize the token state variable inside the constructor.
_wallet is only used to initialize the wallet state variable inside the constructor.
_beneficiaries is only consumed by the sendToken loop and its transferFrom call.
_amount is only consumed by the sendToken transferFrom call.
